newsitem.title: CHINA: ADB has 3.3 pct stake in Everbright Bank - China.
newsitem.headline: ADB has 3.3 pct stake in Everbright Bank - China.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has taken a 3.3 percent stake in the Everbright Bank of China with a recent $20 million investment, the official Xinhua news agency said.

"The investment is the first direct foreign involvement in a Chinese financial institution," Xinhua late on Tuesday quoted Qi Li, head of Everbright Bank's funding and restructuring office, as saying.
The ADB had previously said it would inject $20 million in equity into Everbright and lend the bank $60 million.
The ADB would make a 15-year $60 million loan to the Chinese government, which would relend the money to Everbright Bank, Qi said.
The ADB had also pledged $600,000 in technical assistance to Everbright, one of six nationwide commercial banks in China, Qi said.
"We're transforming our bank into a shareholding commercial bank, and ADB's participation will improve our rating in the international financial market," Qi said.
Everbright now had a capital value of 4.4 billion yuan ($530 million) and its assets totalled 33.7 billion yuan at the end of 1995, Xinhua said.
